fields.industryDescription: US boutique luxury leisure travel advisors: owner-led, bespoke trip designers selling high-end travel to affluent Americans who want a reliable UK & Ireland partner on the ground. Independent agencies and owner-advisors inside consortia (Signature, Virtuoso, Tzell/FROSCH member shops).
fields.companySize: Solo advisor to ~50 people. Boutique-to-small is the sweet spot.
fields.exclusions: Corporate / business-travel agencies (TMCs), big network HQs (FROSCH/Tzell corporate), cruise-only retail, and mass-market or budget agencies. Anyone not selling bespoke luxury leisure.

offer.serviceDescription: Bespoke, full-package luxury journeys through Ireland, Northern Ireland, Scotland, England and Wales, designed for American travelers. Tiernan is the UK & Ireland ground partner: the advisor sells, Tiernan designs and runs the trip.
offer.uniqueAngle: Family-owned, 20+ years, luxury and quality over quantity. Full bespoke only, never short city breaks or hop-on-hop-off. B2B only: works solely with advisors, never direct-to-consumer, so the client relationship stays the advisor's.
guarantees: Your clients always stay yours: a white-label partnership
Bespoke proposals turned around in 24-48 hours
20+ years of on-the-ground UK & Ireland expertise
Full-package journeys handled end to end
problemsSolved: Finding a trustworthy UK & Ireland ground partner who won't poach the client
Designing genuinely bespoke luxury itineraries instead of cookie-cutter packages
Getting fast, reliable proposals during a busy season
On-the-ground logistics and quality control for discerning American travelers
offer.quantifiableResults: 20+ years of UK & Ireland experience; ETOA member; partnered with Tourism Ireland, Visit Britain, Visit Scotland and Visit Wales; real advisor testimonials (a US advisor who 'sent five families this summer,' problems 'solved within minutes,' itineraries that are 'not cookie-cutter'). Proposals delivered in 24-48 hours; clients who stay for good (high lifetime value).
process: Hop on a call and share your voice, the client's dates, interests and preferences
Tiernan designs a bespoke UK/Ireland proposal in 24-48 hours
You present it to your client under your own brand
Tiernan runs the trip on the ground; you keep the relationship
offer.frontEndOffer: A complimentary sample UK/Ireland itinerary, sent as the first touch. A partnership introduction, not a hard sell.

Hello Simon,

I noticed that <Company Name> is focused on wine-tasting tours to Spain and Portugal, but I didn't see a dedicated UK/Ireland option in your portfolio.

Open to seeing the draft?

items.q: "Is that net or commissionable? What are your rates?"
items.a: Don't quote cold. "For a real number I'd need the client's dates, party size, interests and accommodation level. I can turn a proposal around in 24-48h."
items.ask: Net rates vs commission? Typical advisor margin?

items.q: "Can you share credentials, references or reviews?" (luxury advisors always ask)
items.a: 20+ years, family-owned; ETOA member; partners with Tourism Ireland, Visit Britain, Visit Scotland, Visit Wales; advisor testimonials (e.g. a US advisor who 'sent five families this summer').
items.ask: References we can name + permission to use them; licensing/bonding/insurance?

items.q: "Are you a Virtuoso or Signature preferred partner?" (your targets ARE Signature members)
items.ask: Confirm preferred/affiliate status. This one matters a lot for this audience.

items.q: "How do you typically work? What do you need from me?"
items.a: You sell and keep the client; we design and run it on the ground. To quote: client dates, party size, interests, accommodation level, arrival city. Proposal back in 24-48h.

items.q: "Do you cover Scotland, England, Wales? Can you combine Ireland and Scotland?"
items.a: Yes. Ireland, Northern Ireland, Scotland, England, Wales. Multi-country UK & Ireland trips are our core.
Luxury, full-package and bespoke: boutique-to-5-star to the client's standard, private drivers/transfers throughout. (A testimonial cites a private driver for a full 2-week trip.)

items.q: "Can you share photos I can use on social?"
